title: Protein intake and muscle hypertrophy in resistance-trained adults
content: Higher daily protein intake (1.6 g/kg) increased lean mass gains during twelve weeks of resistance training compared with the recommended dietary allowance.

title: Creatine supplementation and strength
content: Creatine monohydrate supplementation improved one-repetition maximum strength in the bench press and squat in trained men and women.

title: Sleep duration and recovery
content: Athletes sleeping fewer than seven hours showed slower recovery of muscle strength and higher perceived soreness after eccentric exercise.

title: Training volume dose response
content: Weekly set volume showed a graded dose-response relationship with muscle hypertrophy, with protein intake held constant across groups.

title: Caffeine and endurance performance
content: Caffeine ingestion one hour before exercise improved time-trial endurance performance in cyclists.

title: Hydration status and cognitive function
content: Mild dehydration of two percent body mass impaired attention and short-term memory in healthy adults.
